user.title: Sign in to Home Connect
user.description: Open [this address]({url}) and sign in with the account the app uses. The browser will end on a Home Connect page that looks blank or broken; that is expected. Copy the whole address out of the address bar and paste it below.

data_description.code: The whole address out of the address bar, not just part of it. It is only good once and only here.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Home Connect again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored sign in has stopped working. Open [this address]({url}), sign in with the same account, and paste the address the browser ends on below.

data_description.code: The whole address out of the address bar, not just part of it. It is only good once and only here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Home Connect. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: That address was not accepted. A code is only good once and only for a few minutes, so open the address above again and sign in afresh.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different account. Sign in with the one this entry was set up for.
